# Code

- Read `REPO-ROOT/.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
- Read `REPO-ROOT/Project.md`.

## Goal

- This is the default direct-work path when the request is not phase-prefixed.
- Prefer implementing the requested change immediately.

## Rules

- follow the repository baseline and MV3 boundary rules
- use `Playwright -> MCP` for browser validation order
- keep edits focused
- if the request is really a phase-management request, move the relevant
  `.github/TaskLogs` artifact forward instead of improvising a parallel process
